description.default: One menu behind a top-bar icon, both chores scoped to the current document: rename the attachments of the current document to match their anchor texts (the SiYuan timestamp-random suffix is kept, and any link elsewhere that points at the same file follows along so nothing breaks), or export every attachment and image of the current document into a randomly named temp folder, numbered 001- in document order and opened automatically when done.
description.zh_CN: 顶栏图标弹出菜单，两件事都只作用于当前文档：① 按锚文本把当前文档里的附件改成锚文本里的名字（保留思源的时间戳-随机码；别的文档若引用了同一文件，链接自动跟着不走空）；② 一键把当前文档的全部附件和图片按正文顺序编号 001- 导出到随机命名的临时文件夹，导完自动打开。
